entities.summary: Schloss Moritzburg is a Schloss (palace) in Zeitz on the White Elster in the Burgenlandkreis in Saxony-Anhalt. The present baroque building dates from the 17th century. Before that, it was a royal palace and fortified seat of a bishop. The Zeitz Cathedral of St. Peter and Paul is also located on the site.
